The workbook generation failed due to #NAME? errors in the statistics section, indicating invalid Excel formulas or missing function definitions.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected floating-point values (e.g., H46 expected -2.7657, got #NAME?). This error typically occurs when a formula uses a function name that Excel/openpyxl does not recognize or a named range that hasn't been defined. While the 'net metric' assertions passed, the 'statistics' matrix remains broken.
